name: recombine and mutate selected parents
mechanism: select parents in proportion to fitness, produce children by exchanging segments of their encodings and randomly altering positions, and replace the population, so useful segments spread while variation continues

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Genetic algorithms' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Gene expression programming':

requires: an encoding where segments carry meaning (a human prior)
fails_when: disruptive crossover when the encoding does not localise meaning
